design: Fresh batch of three prespecified independent-velocity cis,cis linoleate repeats; identical validated prepared inputs; all outcomes retained; no directed ternary formation or outcome-driven restarts.

branches.FA: WT–DPH plus one exterior (9Z,12Z)-linoleate carboxylate, CAS60-33-3

conditions.solvent: Original endpoint water/PBS/nominal5% v/v DMSO retained; overlapping water replaced during competitor insertion; addedNa neutralizes -1 competitor

analysis_preregistration.reference: This resident DPH endpoint; fit 170 protein core C-alpha atoms
track: DPH–protein minimum heavy distance and contacting residues
DPH displacement/RMSD relative resident starting pose
DPH SASA, water and DMSO neighborhoods
competitor proximity to original DPH occupied coordinates
DPH projection along initial exterior direction
Simultaneous three-pair heavy-atom contacts below 4.5 A, fraction and longest contiguous saved-frame episode; proximity is not affinity or closed-cavity binding.
analysis_preregistration.interpretation: Joint changes in competitor proximity and resident DPH position/exposure must be compared with controls and all repeats. No displacement claim from RMSD alone. No artificial-force trajectories will be labelled spontaneous. No calibrated Kd or binding-rate estimate.

limitations: Source endpoint chosen post hoc; conditional mechanism test, not independent validation of selected pocket.
Targeted exterior placement; millimolar local 1:1:1 models, not 8:1:10 experimental micromolar ratio.
5ns per repeat is an initial exploratory window; no-event does not exclude competition at longer times.
Linoleate/DMSO/phosphate transferable candidate parameters; mixture thermodynamics and binding energetics not independently validated.
resource_policy: Serial GPU execution after prior competition queue has released GPU; three predeclared cis-linoleate repeats; no concurrent GPU jobs.
